_comment: Shared by internal/analyze/ioblocks_case_test.go (IOHotOn, IODensityOn, IOMapWith reads) and web/src/lib/data/ioblocks.test.ts (ioHotOf, ioDensityOf, ioMapOf reads). Generated from testdata/traces/19c/io_waits.trc by `go test ./internal/analyze -run IOBlocksSharedCase -update-ioblocks-case`, do not edit: events = the trace's doc.events, waits = the doc.facts.waits columns of its waits up to the 60th block I/O wait, then from 300 block I/O waits before statement 22's first one to 800 after it (flags bit0 between, bit1 idle); hot, density and reads are queries (options, optional stmt, window from/to with 0 = open) and the answers of /api/io/hot, /api/io/density and /api/io/map?reads=1 for them, some with caps small enough that the counting prunes.
